_doc: The models the fleet may run on, best first. Headless runs (make fleet-next) take the first one that is
installed, offered by its CLI and not out of quota; when a run hits a quota, usage or rate limit, that model
rests until its reset time (target/fleet/models.json) and the next one takes over, in any tool. A run waits
only when every model is resting. `make fleet-models` shows the chain and what is resting.
tools: the order tools are tried in (AGENT=<tool> puts that one first). chain: that tool's models, best
first; null = the tool's own default model. agy also uses any other model `agy models` lists, after these.
roles: what the roster's model tiers (pro, flash) become in Claude Code's subagents; inherit = the model
the session runs on, so the roles follow the runner to whichever model has quota left.
